opportunities.title: Open Scheme 09/26

opportunities.summary: Support for activities not covered by another Society scheme, all of which should support the Society's mission.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Public Engagement Scheme 09/26

opportunities.summary: Support for activities related to the promotion of public awareness and understanding of pathology.

opportunities.summary: To promote research in pathology to fund short projects for early career clinical academic research trainee pathologists for periods of 3, 6, 9, 12 months, providing salary and/or research expenses.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland

opportunities.summary: To provide 3 years of PhD funding for medically qualified trainees in Histopathology or other tissue specialities within Pathology to increase research skills, abilities and interests in tissue-based research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland

opportunities.summary: Support for a four year PhD, including stipend, research & training allowance, conference allowance and consumables.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Hodgkin Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

opportunities.summary: To encourage early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Leishman Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain or Ireland in a Foundation year 1 or 2 post or a Trainee 1-3 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: To encourage early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Post-Doctoral Collaborative Small Grant 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Consultant's Pump Priming Small Grant 10/26

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Equipment Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000 per application

opportunities.title: International Collaborative Grant Scheme 10/26

opportunities.summary: To develop and/or strengthen collaboration in scholarly pathological activities between pathology institutions in Great Britain & Ireland and international institutions.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Cuthbert Dukes Grant Scheme 2027

opportunities.summary: To encourage early to mid career pathology researchers, in particular academic trainees in the early to mid stages of their career (specialist trainees 2-6) in histopathology, to undertake investigative tissue-based research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £220,000 over a maximum of 4 years, covering 50% of salary costs and up to £20K consumables per year

opportunities.summary: To offer histopathology trainees post PhD/MD who wish to continue research part-time whilst completing clinical training.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Support Grant 10/26

amount.raw: £60,000 per annum funding over a 2 year period, to fund costs of employing a research technician or assistant and associated consumable costs

opportunities.summary: To offer support for continuing research projects over a 2 year period by academic trainee histopathologists following the award of a PhD or MD, when progressing through the final stages of histopathological training.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Intermediate Research Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £120,000 over a maximum of 2 years, covering 50% of salary costs and up to £20K consumables per year

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Summer Studentships 2026

amount.raw: Up to £250 per week, with a maximum of £1,250 per student (equivalent to a 5 week placement)

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Intercalated Degree 11/26

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Medical, dental or veterinary undergraduates who are members of the Society based in UK &/or Ireland.
opportunities.summary: An annual sum to support intercalating degree students (either BSc or MRes/MSc), covering university fees, stipend and consumables.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Education Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: The sum requested should not exceed £5,000

opportunities.summary: Funding to support a range of activities in the performance, development and assessment of undergraduate & postgraduate education in pathology.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Student Society Bursary Scheme

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Winter Pathological Society Travel Bursary for Undergraduates/FD (with RSM) 2027

amount.raw: Costs of up to £350

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate and Foundation Doctor members of the Society. Members awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: To cover costs of up to £350 to attend a Winter Pathological Society meeting, contributing towards travel, accommodation and registration fees.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Travel & Conference Bursary 2026 (external events)

amount.raw: The Travel & Conference bursary is up to £500.00

opportunities.summary: To cover the costs of travel and/or registration fees to promote scientific communications at major international meetings (external events only, not Pathological Society meetings).

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: CRUK / Path Soc Predoctoral Research Bursary

opportunities.summary: Joint Predoctoral Research Bursaries provide short term funding to allow clinicians to get involved in cancer research projects early in their careers, before undertaking a PhD or MD.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Publication Grant Scheme (Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Corresponding Authors who are Society Members in good standing (for a minimum of 12 months) and whose papers have been accepted for publication in the Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research.
